description: Canalisations d'eau et d'assainissement générateurs de servitudes A5, en Eure-et-Loir (28) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. The generator of a public utility easement is a geographical entity whose nature or function induces, by regulation, constraints on the way the land is occupied on the surrounding land.The disappearance or destruction on the site of the generator does not result in the removal of the easement(s) associated with it. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Dataset Direct Download Service (WFS): Water and sewerage pipes generating easements A5, in Eure-et-Loir (28)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include WFS 1.1.0. The listing shows 2019-12-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
